proposal.description: Raise the control task's priority from 30 to 50, above everything else, so nothing can delay it. Same binary; the server channel keeps _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY.
proposal.diff:
--- a/workload arguments
+++ b/workload arguments
@@ -1 +1 @@
-rtdemo -s msgpass
+rtdemo -s msgpass -a 50
